The '''laser cannon''' was a large piece of artillery fielded by the [[Quarren Isolation League/Legends|Quarren Isolation League]], and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in turn, in their battle with [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces.
